## Original Description
SurrealDB before 1.5.5 (and 2.0.0-beta before 2.0.0-beta.3) accepts an arbitrary object in the signin and signup operations of the RPC API without recursively validating it for non-computed values. When a record access method defines a SIGNIN or SIGNUP query and the RPC API is exposed to untrusted users, an unauthenticated attacker can encode a binary object containing a subquery using the bincode serialization format and supply it in place of credentials. The subquery is then executed within the database owner's SIGNIN/SIGNUP query under a system user session with the editor role, allowing the attacker to select, create, update, and delete non-IAM resources (though not view the query results directly, and not affect IAM resources, which require the owner role).", "epss": {"percentage": 0.00636, "percentile": 0.4775}, "ghsa_id": "GHSA-xw2c-hrr9-4xwr", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-09-04T18:41:12Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-xw2c-hrr9-4xwr", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-xw2c-hrr9-4xwr"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2024-58362"}], "nvd_published_at": "2026-07-18T14:17:09Z", "published_at": "2026-07-18T15:31:48Z", "references": ["https://github.com/surrealdb/surrealdb/security/advisories/GHSA-64f8-pjgr-9wmr", "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-58362", "https://www.vulncheck.com/advisories/surrealdb-before-query-injection-via-rpc-api", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-xw2c-hrr9-4xwr"], "repository_advisory_url": null, "severity": "high", "source_code_location": "", "summary": "Duplicate Advisory: Untrusted Query Object Evaluation in RPC API", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-09-04T18:41:15Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-xw2c-hrr9-4xwr", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": null, "package": {"ecosystem": "rust", "name": "surrealdb"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "< 1.5.5"}], "withdrawn_at": "2026-09-04T18:41:12Z"}
